# FluteSangam

> FluteSangam is a learning platform, community, and reference repository for Indian Classical Bansuri (Bamboo Flute) music, Sargam notations, Alankaras, and Raga guides.

## Core Reference Modules

- [Introduction to Bansuri](https://flutesangam.com/learn/intro): Guide on Bansuri anatomy, history, grip mechanics, and embouchure technique.
- [The Basics: Sound & Grip](https://flutesangam.com/learn/basics): Foundational finger placement, posture, blowing angle, and producing clear notes across octaves.
- [Choose the Right Flute](https://flutesangam.com/learn/choose-flute): Scale selection guide (C Medium, G Base, A Base) matched to hand span, age group, and vocal pitch.
- [Interactive Fingering Chart](https://flutesangam.com/learn/fingering-chart): Visual hole coverage diagrams for Shuddha, Komal, and Teevra swaras across 3 octaves.
- [Alankaras (Musical Patterns)](https://flutesangam.com/learn/alankaras): Structured daily warmups and finger speed drills for beginner, intermediate, and advanced flutists.
- [Daily Practice Guide](https://flutesangam.com/learn/daily-practice-guide): 30-minute daily Swar Sadhana, long tone holding, and raga chalan exercises.
- [Classical Ragas Guide](https://flutesangam.com/learn/raagas): Analyses of Indian classical ragas including Aroha, Avaroha, Pakad, Vadi, Samvadi, time of day, and practice compositions.
- [Song Notations & Requests](https://flutesangam.com/notations): Sargam notations and request board for classical compositions, devotional bhajans, and songs.
- [Flute FAQ & Knowledge Base](https://flutesangam.com/faq): Answers to questions on bamboo flute selection, blowing technique, care, and classical ragas.
- [Flute Care & Maintenance](https://flutesangam.com/faq/flute-care-and-maintenance): Practical guide to bamboo flute oiling, binding, temperature safety, and cleaning.

## Citation & Information

- Domain: https://flutesangam.com
- Resource Type: Flute Educational Platform & Community
- Citation Format: "FluteSangam (https://flutesangam.com)"
